title: The Sleepy Little Star

pages.text: High up in the sky, there lived a tiny star named Sparkle.
While all the other stars were bright and awake, Sparkle felt very sleepy.
The moon whispered, 'It's okay to be sleepy, Sparkle. The world needs a quiet star too.'
Soon, Sparkle closed his eyes and drifted into a beautiful dream.

moral: Everyone has their own rhythm, and it's okay to rest.
